metadata.name: availability-grid-picker
metadata.description: A weekly calendar-style grid for picking recurring availability by clicking or drag-selecting half-hour cells across 7 days.
features: 7-day x half-hour grid, click or click-and-drag across cells to toggle availability
Automatically merges contiguous selected half-hour cells per day into start/end time ranges
Pre-fills selection from an initialSlots prop (array of {day_of_week, start_time, end_time})
Exposes the merged result as a component variable so other elements/workflows can read it
Configurable visible hour range and start-of-week
Per-day 'select whole day' quick button under each day header to mark the entire visible range as available in one click

properties.name: initialSlots
properties.description: Existing slots to pre-select, as an array of {day_of_week: 0-6 (0=Sunday), start_time: 'HH:MM', end_time: 'HH:MM'}.

properties.name: startHour
properties.description: First visible hour on the grid (0-23).

properties.name: endHour
properties.description: Last visible hour on the grid, exclusive of the final half-hour past it (0-23).

events.name: change
events.description: Fires whenever the selection changes. Payload value is the merged slots array.

variables.name: selectedSlots
variables.description: The current selection, merged into contiguous ranges per day: array of {day_of_week, start_time, end_time}.

specifications: Days are always Sunday(0) through Saturday(6) as columns, left to right.
Rows are half-hour increments between startHour and endHour.
Click a single cell to toggle it. Press and drag across cells to paint multiple cells to the same state as the first cell clicked (select or deselect).

Contiguous selected half-hour cells within the same day column are merged into a single start_time/end_time range in the exported data — a teacher selecting 9:00, 9:30, and 10:00 produces one range 09:00-10:30, not three separate entries.
Each day header has a small 'All day' button that instantly selects every visible half-hour cell for that day.
Selection state is entirely local until read via the selectedSlots variable or the change event — nothing is persisted by the component itself.
